boundary: real production pages and public test assets; no issuer custody or mainnet claim
browser: Chromium; temporary in-memory wallets only; installed wallets not used

stages.name: guided: prepare two disposable server wallets

limits: Local transactions using test assets and an accelerated test year.
Raydium executes from captured genuine devnet bytecode; these signatures are not public devnet signatures.
Test USDC uses an exact Circle devnet mint clone with synthetic local balances, not faucet transfers or public USDC.

limits.intentionalFaucetReplay: One identical request after confirmation checks idempotence; no new grant is expected.
limits.cleanup: No hidden delete; isolation performs the one specified reset and other VMs hard-expire.
